summary_notes: Outbound sales discovery call with Marguerite, director of operations at Tidewell Home Care (home health agency, ~85 users incl. 25 per-diem contractors, corrected from 60). Current vendor had a staff-data breach last spring; their contract ends January 15, so Tidewell must be live on a replacement before then. Pain points: handoffs, coordinator/field communication, rural connectivity, adoption risk. Needs calendar sync and accounting integration; field staff will record visit notes containing PHI in tasks. Pricing discussed: Team $14/seat/mo, Enterprise $26/seat/mo annual; rep offered up to 15% discount and disclosed Halloway Pediatrics pays $9/seat. Security review with compliance officer Theodora set for Tue Oct 6, 10 a.m.; 85-seat proposal due Friday.
